narr: Slow-moving thunderstorms on July 12, 2025, produced flash flooding across portions of New Orleans. Water was reported flowing over the curb at Bienville and Royal Streets in the French Quarter, while flooding was also observed at Calliope and Camp Street. Broadcast media showed video of water covering part of Rampart Street and approaching the entrance of a building.
ev: Trained spotter reports water flowing over the curb on the corner of Bienville and Royal Streets in the French Quarter.
Calliope and Camp Street flooded according to Streetwise NOLA.
Broadcast media reports flash flooding on Rampart Street. Video shows water covering part of the road and water was approaching the entrance to a building.
